#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
constexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 1000000;
constexpr int MOD1 = 998244353;
constexpr int MOD2 = 1000000007;

ll n, counter;
vector<int> buckets[7];
int bucket_sums[7], answer, total_count;

inline int mod_reduce(ll x) {
    return static_cast<int>((x % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
}

void build_buckets(int depth, ll prefix) {
    ++counter;
    buckets[depth].push_back(mod_reduce(counter - prefix));
    if (depth == 6) return;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        build_buckets(depth + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
    }
}

void query_range(int depth, ll current_value) {
    if (current_value > n) return;
    
    if (depth >= 1) {
        if (current_value * BLOCK_SIZE > n / 10 && (current_value + 1) * BLOCK_SIZE - 1 <= n) {
            int multiplier = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i, multiplier *= 10) {
                int complement = mod_reduce(counter - multiplier * current_value);
                auto it = lower_bound(buckets[i].begin(), buckets[i].end(), MOD1 - complement);
                int idx = it - buckets[i].begin();
                answer = (answer + 1LL * complement * buckets[i].size() % MOD2 + bucket_sums[i] - 1LL * MOD1 * (static_cast<int>(buckets[i].size()) - idx)) % MOD2;
            }
            counter += total_count;
            return;
        }
        ++counter;
        answer = (answer + mod_reduce(counter - current_value)) % MOD2;
    }
    
    for (int digit = (depth == 0); digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        query_range(depth + 1, current_value * 10 + digit);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n;
    build_buckets(0, 0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
        sort(buckets[i].begin(), buckets[i].end());
        bucket_sums[i] = accumulate(buckets[i].begin(), buckets[i].end(), 0LL) % MOD2;
    }
    
    total_count = counter;
    counter = 0;
    query_range(0, 0);
    
    cout << (answer + MOD2) % MOD2 << '\n';
    return 0;
}
